decision_reason: PLS established the strongest raw-time baseline under the proxy-removed contract.
Cyclic time encoding improved the adjusted R2 control on identical folds.
The bounded grid selected alpha=0.01 and l1_ratio=0.9 without holdout feedback.
The four disclosed composite proxies did not improve adjusted or raw OOF R2.
CatBoost and LightGBM both underperformed the tuned Elastic Net.
Leakage-safe residual correction did not exceed the unchanged base Elastic Net.
Targeted spline nonlinearities did not provide a material improvement.
PLS and PCR compression did not outperform sparse regularization.
RBF and Nystroem approximations lost substantial adjusted R2.
The 80%-to-100% gain and full-data generalization gap satisfied the frozen stop rule.
